{{Short description|Mexican mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=November 2022}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=November 2022}}
'''María Asunción Begoña Fernández Fernández''' (published as Begoña Fernández) is a Mexican mathematician specializing in [[probability theory]], [[stochastic process]]es, and [[mathematical finance]].{{r|as}} She is a professor of mathematics at the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM).{{r|dir}}

==Education==
Fernández studied mathematics at UNAM, graduating in 1979. She earned a master's degree in [[statistics]] and [[operations research]] in 1986, and completed her doctorate at [[CINVESTAV]] in 1990.{{r|dir|lance}}

==Recognition==
Fernández is a member of the [[Mexican Academy of Sciences]].{{r|amc}}
